definitions.explanation: A situation requiring immediate action or attention. Also used as a noun modifier ({緊急|きんきゅう}の or {緊急|きんきゅう}～) to describe something as urgent or emergency-related.

examples.japanese: {緊急|きんきゅう}{事態|じたい}が{発生|はっせい}した。
{緊急|きんきゅう}の{連絡|れんらく}が{入|はい}りました。
examples.english: An urgent message has come in.

examples.japanese: {地震|じしん}のあと、{政府|せいふ}は{緊急|きんきゅう}{会議|かいぎ}を{開|ひら}いて{対策|たいさく}を{話|はな}し{合|あ}った。
examples.english: After the earthquake, the government held an emergency meeting to discuss countermeasures.

notes:
{緊急|きんきゅう} indicates something requiring immediate attention or action.

WORD FORMATION:
{緊|きん} (tense, tight) + {急|きゅう} (urgent, sudden)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {緊急|きんきゅう}{事態|じたい}: emergency situation
- {緊急|きんきゅう}{会議|かいぎ}: emergency meeting
- {緊急|きんきゅう}{速報|そくほう}: breaking news, emergency bulletin
- {緊急|きんきゅう}{連絡|れんらく}: urgent communication
- {緊急|きんきゅう}{搬送|はんそう}: emergency transport (ambulance)
- {緊急|きんきゅう}{着陸|ちゃくりく}: emergency landing

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {急|きゅう}: sudden, urgent (more casual)
- {至急|しきゅう}: urgent, immediately (used in business/written contexts)
